references.text: The fulfillment of the prophecy: locusts filled all the houses in Egypt, just as Moses warned Pharaoh.
A similar plague where frogs filled the houses of Pharaoh, his servants, and all of Egypt.
Similar expressions about a plague that has not been seen since Egypt was founded.
Another plague described as worse than anything that has happened before or will happen again.
Joel describes a locust plague that is worse than anything the fathers or earlier generations have seen.
The locusts enter the houses, a parallel to the locust plague in Egypt.
Moses leaves Pharaoh after giving the warning, the same pattern as here.
Revelation describes locusts as an end-times plague, with reference to the locust plague in Egypt.
A direct narrative parallel in the plague account where the same groups (servants and people) are mentioned as targets of God's action.
The warning that houses will be filled (10:6) is fulfilled in the final judgment where every house has a death (12:30).
